svg.text: µs per day, against a clock on the ground
gps · satellite clocks · general + special relativity
clocks in orbit gain 38.6 µs a day: light runs 11.6 km in that time
set them slow on the ground: 10.22999999543 MHz, not 10.23

text.tspan: # both effects, measured every day: GPS is a working test of Einstein
